cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: This Pokémon was born in a special land. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.description: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: It uses the fine fur on its body to sense movement in the air and predict the weather...as well as its foes' thoughts.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.description: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.description: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.description: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.description: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.description: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it's very picky about food.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in the darkness, waiting for prey.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: It's said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.description: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Gholdengo
cards.description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.description: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.description: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.description: It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Hisuian Zorua
cards.description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

cards.name: Hisuian Zoroark
cards.description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

cards.name: Minior
cards.description: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
